element_fields.help_en:
The custom tag key specified by the user.

The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length, cannot start with `dw:`, and supports only letters, digits, and the following special characters: `-@#*<>|[]()+=&%$!~`
element_fields.help_zh:
用户输入的自定义标签键。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`dw:`开头，仅支持中英文数字和部分符号`-@#*<>|[]()+=&%$!~`
element_fields.name: key

parameters.help_en:
The list of tags associated with data assets. Tags are used as query filters:
Multiple values have an OR relationship. For example, `["key1:v1", "key2:v1", "key3:v1"]` queries data assets that contain any one of the specified tags.
If this parameter is not specified or is left empty, no tag-based filtering is applied
parameters.help_zh:
数据资产关联的标签列表，基于标签做查询过滤：
多个值之间是“或”的关系，比如`["key1:v1", "key2:v1", "key3:v1"]`底层查询包含任一一个标签的数据资产。
不传递，或者传递为空表示不作tag过滤
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en: The list of unique data asset IDs
parameters.name: data_asset_ids

parameters.help_en:
The Asset Type of the data asset. Valid values:

ACS::DataWorks::Table: data table.

ACS::DataWorks::Task: scheduling node
parameters.help_zh:
数据资产类型

数据表（ACS::DataWorks::Table）

调度任务（ACS::DataWorks::Task）
parameters.name: data_asset_type

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10条，最大为100条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The workspace environment to which the data asset belongs. Valid values:
Dev: development environment.
Prod: production environment
parameters.help_zh:
数据资产所属的工作空间环境，包括
Dev（开发环境）
Prod（生产环境）
parameters.name: env_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the asset domain
parameters.name: asset_domain_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the asset category
parameters.name: category_uuid

parameters.help_en: The name of the asset. Fuzzy search by name is supported
parameters.help_zh: 资产名称，支持按名称模糊搜索
parameters.name: name
